title: Baby Leo and Friends Learn About Friendship
summary: Today, Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, and Marjona discover the magic of friendship! They learn how friends support each other and make each other feel happy. Together, they show that being a good friend is all about being there for each other.
lesson: Kids learn about friendship and how to support each other.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, and Marjona are playing together in the sunny park. They are laughing and having fun.
Baby Leo remembers how they helped each other in past adventures. He suggests they celebrate their friendship today.
Bella has a clever idea! She says they can make friendship bracelets to show how much they care about each other.
They gather colorful strings and start making their bracelets. Bobo is a little shy and thinks he won't do it well.
Marjona encourages Bobo, saying it’s okay to ask for help. They all work together to make beautiful bracelets.
Twinkle joins them and sprinkles some magic, making the bracelets shine brightly.
Later, they sit in a circle and share what they love about each other. Everyone feels happy and loved.
Bobo realizes he can be brave and shares a funny story that makes everyone laugh.
They all finish their bracelets and promise to always support each other.
The friends smile and hug, excited to wear their bracelets as a symbol of their friendship.
